summary: Routes TOP video to native output hardware from Blackmagic, Bluefish444, AJA, or Deltacast devices.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Enable or disable output card transmission

key_params.name: library
key_params.note: Native driver library such as Blackmagic, Bluefish444, AJA, or Deltacast

key_params.name: device
key_params.note: Detected hardware output device

key_params.name: signalformat
key_params.note: Resolution, frame rate, and progressive/interlaced output format

key_params.name: outputpixelformat
key_params.note: Output bit depth and key/alpha format where supported

key_params.name: outputcolorformat
key_params.note: YUV 4:2:2 or RGB 4:4:4 output format where supported

key_params.name: chop
key_params.note: Legacy audio CHOP parameter present in the official docs

key_params.name: audiochop
key_params.note: Time-sliced audio CHOP to embed in output

key_params.name: audiobitdepth
key_params.note: Embedded audio bit depth

key_params.name: bufferlength
key_params.note: Audio buffer length to avoid crackles and pops

key_params.name: referencesource
key_params.note: AJA reference input source

key_params.name: manualfield
key_params.note: Manual field control for interlaced output

key_params.name: firstfield
key_params.note: Current frame is first field for interlaced output

key_params.name: timecodeop
key_params.note: CHOP, DAT, or Timecode object to embed timecode

key_params.name: transfermode
key_params.note: GPU-to-output-card transfer strategy

key_params.name: syncoutputs
key_params.note: Synchronize supported multiple output nodes

key_params.name: syncgroupindex
key_params.note: Sync group for synchronized output nodes

key_params.name: resetstats
key_params.note: Reset attached Info CHOP statistics

key_params.name: colorspace
key_params.note: Output color-space conversion

key_params.name: outputreferencewhite
key_params.note: Reference-white treatment for SDR/HDR output

common_gotchas: Choose Library before selecting Device because device menu contents depend on the driver library.
YUV 4:2:2 lowers bandwidth but loses color information compared with RGB 4:4:4.
Interlaced workflows need field parity control from an Info CHOP or matching source pipeline to avoid stutter.
Sync Outputs requires Pro and supported hardware; Blackmagic generally needs a connected Genlock source.
Color-space metadata support depends on the output form and device.
key_concepts: Video Device Out TOP sends TOP video to native hardware output devices from Blackmagic, Bluefish444, AJA, or Deltacast.
Signal format defines output resolution, frame rate, and interlace mode while pixel and color format choose hardware encoding layout.
Audio and timecode can be embedded through CHOP, DAT, or timecode object workflows.
Synchronized output is a Pro-only workflow that depends on supported/genlocked hardware.
